senses.gloss: to split, divide, branch off; to peel, lay bare.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 6:5">Bekh. VI, 5</cite>, v. infra.—Part. pass. <he>מְפוּצָּל</he>; f. <he>מְפוּצֶּלֶת</he>; pl. <he>מְפוּצָּלִים</he>, <he>מְפוּצָּלִין</he>; <he>מְפוּצָּלוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 11:6">Men. XI, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Menachot 96a:12">96ᵃ</cite>) <he>מפ׳ מראשיהן</he> (Mish. ed. <he>מוּפְצָלִין</he>) forked at the top; Tosef. ib. XI, 7; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 369:3">Yalk. Ex. 369</cite>.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 685:1">Yalk. Ps. 685</cite>, v. infra.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 6:5">Bekh. VI, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Bekhorot 39b">39ᵇ</cite>) <he>היה … מַפְצִיל עצם</he> Mish. (Bab. ed. <he>מְפַצֵּל</he>) if the top end (root) of the tail divides the bone (i.e. if the backbone is branched at the place where the tail begins; Rashi <he>מפציל את העצם</he> peels the backbone, i.e. if the end of the backbone is bare of skin and flesh).

<cite ref="Yoma 29a:3">Yoma 29ᵃ</cite> <he>מה אילה זו קרניה מַפְצִילוֹת לכאן ולכאן אף שחר זה מפציע וכ׳</he> as the antlers of the hind branch off this way and that way, so the light of dawn spreads &c.; (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 685:1">Yalk. Ps. 685</cite> … <he>מפוצלות … מְפַצֵּל וכ׳</he>). Yoma l. c. <he>כל זמן שמגדלת קרניה מפצילות</he> as long as it grows, its antlers form additional branches every year; Yalk. l. c.

<cite ref="Niddah 47a:59">Nidd. 47ᵃ</cite> (expl. <he>משיכסיף</he>) <he>משיפְצִיל ראש החוטם</he> (Ar. <he>משיִפָּצֵל</he>) when the skin of the central circle of the oblate part of the breast appears wrinkled.
